backlogged.summary: The disable check in lib/sleep.mjs runs after the platform check. On win32 or other unsupported platforms the label is 'not supported on <platform>', not 'disabled by HARNESS_TEST_NO_SLEEP_INHIBITOR', even when the variable is '1'. This matches the contract, which only names darwin and linux, but the label differs by platform.

The F77 AC-1 and AC-2 tests wait a fixed 1 s before asserting that the fake inhibitor never ran. AC-2 also builds up to 9 fixtures. Under load the 1 s may be too short to prove the negative, and test/stress.mjs does not cover it.
